title: READ THE WHOLE POST  AI Website Builder + Local SEO Specialist — Skilled, Long-Term Job  PAID TRIAL BUILD
description:
Client Website styles we want: 
, 
, 



What you'll do



-Build marketing websites for local service businesses — sites made to rank on Google and turn visitors into calls, bookings, and leads. Build them fast, using AI builders, our templates, our finished copy, and our brand assets.

-Start steady, then speed up. In your first 60 days you build our first template set and 1 to 2 client sites.

-Build our template library with us over your first months. We design each template in Figma — you build it pixel-perfect, fast, and mobile-ready. We call our templates "structures." Clients pick one from a menu. 80% of a build is the template. 20% is swapping images, copy, and colors.

-Make a preview site from a template in under an hour when we need one for a prospect. Speed wins us clients — that is the whole reason we work with AI builders and templates.

-Connect every site to Aspire, the app platform we built just for our agency. Every client gets their own dashboard in Aspire. That means contact forms that send leads straight into the client's dashboard, Google Analytics 4, and the Meta Pixel with an event on every button. When a booking widget blocks the pixel, we show you the workaround patterns we already use (server-side and form-based) — you implement and test them.

-Do local SEO for our clients. This means: Google Business Profile, city + service keywords, page titles and meta descriptions, NAP consistency (same name, address, phone everywhere), site speed, and schema markup (code that helps Google understand the page). This same work helps clients get recommended by Google's AI results — reviews, profile activity, and clean structured data all count there. You send a short monthly report in plain English. Reports are templated.

-Follow the brief, the brand deck, and the finished copy we give you. Never let an AI tool rewrite our copy. You can suggest better layouts, sections, and SEO ideas — we want your brain, not just your hands.

-Join a short call a couple of times each week so we stay on the same page.





What we give you





-Finished copy, brand colors and fonts, logos, and real photos — organized and labeled. You never write copy from scratch or hunt for assets.

-A build checklist and example sites for every project. A clear design system: mobile-first, one repeated call-to-action, sticky call/book bar, real named testimonials, fast load times.

-A regular call, so you are never guessing.





Who we're looking for



The two most important things to us are skill and good communication.



Skill: You can take a template, finished copy, and assets, and ship a finished, fast, mobile-perfect website on your own. You are fast with AI builders — you use them to move quickly without losing quality. We build in 10Web, an AI builder on WordPress, but if you work faster in another modern AI builder, tell us. Strong WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, or Framer experience transfers. Whatever the builder, you can go into the code and fix HTML, CSS, and small JavaScript problems yourself — not just drag and drop. And you have done real local SEO with results you can show.

Communication: You write and speak English clearly. You ask questions when a brief is not clear. You give updates on your own, so we do not need to chase you. You finish your work on time.



One more thing: so we know you read this whole post, start your message with the words "I like clean builds." Many people do not read this far.



You care about your work. You want to grow with one company. You do not want to juggle ten clients at once.



Requirements





-Very good and very fast with modern AI website builders, and comfortable editing HTML/CSS and making careful small JavaScript fixes. GoHighLevel or other CRM and funnel integration experience is a plus — tell us if you have it.

-Comfortable building from a Figma file — matching spacing, fonts, and layout exactly.

-Real local SEO experience: Google Business Profile, on-page SEO, citations, page speed.

-A portfolio with 3 to 5 live websites you built yourself, in different industries. A few different industries done well tell us more than one industry done many times. Sites built to get calls and leads tell us the most.

-Okay with video calls in English. We hire individuals only, and we verify on a short video call before the trial.

-A computer and internet that let you build and test sites without lag.





The deal





-$1,500 each month to start. This is a flat monthly pay, not by the hour.

-13th month pay. We follow the Philippine standard.

-Pay is reviewed at 90 days. Hit the quality and speed bar and it goes up.

-A steady, long-term job with a team that respects good work.





Don't apply if





-You can only drag and drop and cannot touch code

-You only design and do not do SEO, or you only do SEO and cannot build

-You are an agency, or you want a side gig between other clients

-You go quiet for days and do not reply





How to apply



Reply here on OnlineJobs.ph with:





-Links to 3 to 5 live websites you built yourself. Tell us exactly what you did on each one.

-The tools and builders you use, and how long it takes you to finish a 5-page site when the template and copy are ready.

-One local SEO result you are proud of, with numbers (rankings, calls, Google Business Profile views — anything real).

-A short Loom video: walk through ONE site you built. Show yourself logged into the builder dashboard and explain two decisions you made.





If we like your application, we will pay you for a small test project, about 1 to 2 days of work, paid whether or not we hire you. The test is a small template build plus SEO and tracking setup — the SEO and tracking work matters most to us.



We read every application. We are excited to find the right person to grow with us.

title: Cash Flow Analyst
description:
Cash Flow Analyst for The eCommerce CFO 

(Full-Time, Multiple Clients)



We're The eCommerce CFO, a strategic CFO firm serving eCommerce brands globally. We're a small team focused on delivering quality work for our clients, with no intention of becoming a big firm that stretches itself thin.



What you'll do:



Build and maintain weekly and monthly cash flow forecasts for multiple eCommerce clients

Prepare monthly variance analysis (forecast vs actuals) with clear commentary on what moved and why



Reconcile bank data against forecasts and flag timing gaps early (inventory payments, supplier deposits, ad spend, channel payouts)



Work alongside our bookkeepers and our cash flow and payables coordinator, following our established workbook processes



Communicate findings clearly so the CFO can take them straight to clients



What we're looking for:



2+ years in cash flow forecasting, FP&A or similar analyst role

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (you live in spreadsheets)

Experience with Xero AND QuickBooks

eCommerce exposure preferred: you understand inventory cash timing, channel payouts and seasonality

Reliable, detail-obsessed, and comfortable managing recurring monthly deadlines across several clients

Clear written English



Details:

Full-time and exclusive to The eCommerce CFO (no other clients or side work)

Fully remote, we use Asana and Slack



How to Apply

1. To show you've read this, start your proposal with the word "FORECAST" 

2. Briefly describe a cash flow forecast you've built.

3. Provide me with the 4 letters of your 16 personality/ myres briggs profile.

4. Why you want to work with Judith Hobdell and her team.

Each hook is usually 4–7 seconds long.

Your only job is to assemble them togheter.

WHAT YOU'LL DO



Edit short-form direct response video ads for Meta (Feed, Reels, Stories)

Ad length: 1 to 3 minutes

Deliver each ad with 3 different hook variations per concept: Hook1 + body 1 / Hook2 + body 1 / Hook3 + body 1

title: AI-First Graphic Designer – Static Social Ads (Remote) (EN)
description:
AI-First Graphic Designer – Static Social Ads (Remote) (EN)



Freelance / Full-Time - 100% Remote - Focus: Static Social Ads - Reports to Production & Creative Strategy Teams



What if every static you designed could stop the scroll and be repurposed across dozens of winning campaigns?





We're a performance-driven creative agency building high-converting static ads for paid social (Meta, TikTok). We need a static-first, AI systems thinker who can create scroll-stopping statics and the AI-powered templates, workflows, and frameworks that scale them across our entire client portfolio.



What We Build



Static social ads for e-commerce brands — headline-led statics, point-out ads, product showcases, testimonial graphics, discount badges, and the design systems behind them.



What You'll Do



- Design high-converting static ads for Meta and TikTok

- Build reusable Figma templates that scale across clients

- Reverse-engineer winning ads from other brands into adaptable frameworks

- Use AI image tools (Nano Banana, GPT Image Gen) for product + lifestyle imagery — especially making food and beverage look irresistible

- Design AI-generated creative workflows on platforms like Weavy — turning winning concepts into repeatable, AI-assisted production systems (in partnership with our Creative Strategists)

- Design ad assets/overlays our video editors can plug into video ads

- Set up files so media buyers can make quick text edits without you



?? How We Work



- Design: Figma — organised, component-based, brand-kitted.

- AI workflows: Weavy, Claude Code and other AI platforms — co-built with our Creative Strategist

- Reviews: Quick async feedback loops with creative strategy + media buying

- Comms: Notion + Slack, daily coordination

- Hours: Central European Time



What Makes You Perfect



Essentials



- 2+ years designing social media ads, ideally for e-commerce / D2C

- Expert in Figma — components, templates, brand kits

- You think in systems above everything else. When you see an opportunity to create a workflow, template or system - you take it.

- Portfolio with scroll-stopping statics + at least one design system you've built (required)

- Native/near-native English



Technical Excellence



- Strong grasp of what drives Meta + TikTok + Google ad performance

- Builds clear visual hierarchy — your ads are scannable in 2 seconds

- Experienced with AI image generation for product + lifestyle imagery

- Thinks in AI systems — builds and refines AI-generated creative workflows on platforms like Weavy, in close collaboration with a creative strategist

- Basic animation in Figma/AI tools (nice to have)

- Food & beverage / product styling instincts a strong plus



Systems & Collaboration



- Thinks in frameworks and templates, not one-offs

- Reverse-engineers winning ads into reusable systems

- Multi-project organized — nothing slips

- Experienced managing project work in Notion — tasks, timelines, briefs, and production tracking

- Welcomes feedback, iterates fast, plays well with media buyers + editors



Why You'll Want In



- Scale your impact: Your templates get reused hundreds of times

- Creative + strategic: Design that drives real business results

- A-Player team: Top talent across every department

- 100% remote with a $1,000 annual training budget

- Premium clients: Multi-industry e-commerce portfolio



Output expectation: Multiple static variants per ad set · template systems that scale · proactive comms.



Hiring Process



1. Portfolio review — statics, template systems, AI imagery, conversion focus

2. Intro call with our Creative Strategy / Production Lead (15 min)

3. Creative alignment call with our CEO (20 min)

4. Paid test design (1 brief, 3 static variants + template)

5. Design review + first supervised real ad set





Ready to build design systems that power exceptional campaigns?



If you think in systems, obsess over conversion-focused design, and want to multiply your impact across dozens of winning campaigns — we want to hear from you.





To Apply:



- [ ] Portfolio with your best-performing social ad designs

- [ ] Examples of design systems/workflows you've built for reusability

- [ ] Short note on your approach to those scalable design systems

- [ ] Examples of AI-generated imagery you've shipped in campaigns

- [ ] Your weekly capacity and rate

- [ ] Include the word "banana" somewhere so we know you read this 



Multiply your design impact with us.



With love 



The AOT Team

title: AI-Assisted DM Setter / Inbound Responder
description:
Remote | Full-time | $900 base, top performers $1,400+ with booked-call bonuses

Read this whole thing before applying. The first line of your application must start with "BOOKED" or we won't read it.

The opportunity

We run the inboxes for fast-growing companies' outbound campaigns. When a prospect replies, there's money on the table for the next 5 minutes, and you're the person who closes that window before it shuts. Hit your numbers and you grow into QA lead or client-facing ops within 6 months. This is a performance role. You'll see your reply speed and close rate daily, and top performers earn well above base.

This is not for you if: you get stressed by fast response windows, you go quiet when a conversation gets hard, or you want a job where nobody tracks your output. We measure everything.

What you'll own

You own the inbox. A prospect replies, you read what they actually mean, and you fire back a sharp, natural, on-brand message that moves toward a booked call. You use AI agents to draft and speed up, and you correct them every single time. The judgment is yours. You're also the last line of defense on quality: nothing sloppy or off-tone leaves the inbox on your watch.

Non-negotiables



Native or near-native US business English. You catch nuance, slang, and intent instantly.

Real sales experience. You know how a conversation flows toward a close.

5-minute reply time, every time, for your whole shift.

Never go silent mid-conversation. You stay on an active chat until it's parked or booked.

Rock-solid internet and full availability during working hours.

Fluent in Slack and 
, fast to pick up new tools.



How to apply



Start your message with "BOOKED".

Record a 60-second Loom replying to this real prospect message and explain your thinking:

"Appreciate the message but we already have an SDR team, so not sure this is a fit for us right now."



We'll only review applications with the Loom. This is the exact skill the job requires, so show us you have it.

title: Cold Caller / Speed-to-Lead Closer
description:
**Cold Caller / Speed-to-Lead Closer**

Remote | Full-time | $800/month base, up to $1,500/month with performance bonus



We build and run cold outbound systems for B2B companies. Our campaigns generate warm replies and inbound interest every day. We need someone on the phone who calls those leads within 5 minutes and turns interest into booked calls. The leads are warm. The systems feed you. Your job is to get them on the phone before they cool off.



**The role**

You call warm leads the 
nt they come in. Someone replies to a campaign or fills out a form, you're dialing within 5 minutes. You qualify fast, handle objections, build rapport, and lock in a booked call or a next step. This is speed-to-lead. The difference between a call in 5 minutes and a call in an hour is the difference between a booked meeting and a dead lead.



**What you do**

Call warm leads within 5 minutes of them coming in. Qualify them fast against our criteria. Handle objections without sounding scripted. Build enough rapport to earn the next step. Book qualified prospects onto the calendar. Log every call, outcome, and note cleanly in the CRM. Follow up on leads that don't pick up. Never let a warm lead sit.



**Who you are**

Clear, natural US or UK accent. You sound like someone a US or UK business owner trusts on the phone within the first ten seconds. Real phone sales experience, you've done cold or warm calling and you know how to move a conversation toward a close. Fast on your feet. You think while you talk and you don't freeze when someone pushes back. High energy, high volume, and you don't get discouraged by no's. You treat a 5-minute callback window like money on the table, because it is.



**Non-negotiables**

- Clear, natural US or UK English on the phone. No heavy accent that creates friction.

- Real phone sales / calling experience.

- Available and ready to dial during US business hours, every shift.

- 5-minute callback speed on every warm lead, consistently.

- Rock-solid internet and a quiet space with a good headset. No dropouts, no background noise.

- CRM discipline. Every call logged, every outcome noted.



**Nice to have**

- B2B sales or appointment setting experience

- Experience with speed-to-lead or inbound calling

- Familiarity with CRMs and dialers



**What you get**

Warm leads fed to you daily, no cold list from scratch. Base plus performance comp tied to booked calls, so the better you close the more you earn. Remote, results-driven, and room to grow as we scale.



**How to apply**

1. Start your message with "DIALING".

2. Record a 60-second Loom in your normal speaking voice: introduce yourself and give your pitch for why a busy business owner should stay on the phone with you for 2 more minutes.

3. Tell us your phone sales experience and what hours you can work in US time.



We only review applications with the Loom. This is a phone role, so we need to hear you.

This space changes every single week, and we need someone who genuinely keeps up with the latest AI models, not someone we have to drag along.

In addition to creating AI videos, you should genuinely excel at:



HOOKS & RETENTION: 

Create attention-grabbing openings, fast pacing, and high-retention edits.



PACING: 

Match the energy of the voice-over with snappy, engaging cuts.

Turn scripts into compelling videos using b-roll, text, and supporting visuals.

Source or generate footage that strengthens the message.



CAPTIONS & TEXT:

Create polished text animations and smooth transitions.

Deliver consistent color, seamless edits, and a professional finish.

Keep projects organized, meet deadlines, and communicate clearly.



-----------------------------------

- Weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly payments available.

- Performance bonuses.

- Regular pay increases based on performance.

- 13th-month bonus.



----------------------------

title: AI Video Editor — DTC Creative Ads (Realistic AI Generation)
description:
The Role



We're a DTC brand that lives and dies by creative, and we're looking for an AI video editor who can generate highly realistic, believable AI video — not the uncanny, obviously-synthetic stuff, but footage and avatars that hold up as real ad creative in the feed. You'll turn prompts, product assets, and UGC into scroll-stopping ads for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, using AI generation to produce content that would be slow, expensive, or impossible to shoot.



This is a craft-plus-volume role. The bar is realism: if your AI-generated humans, environments, and product shots pass as authentic and convert like real footage, you'll thrive here.



What You'll Own

Generating photorealistic AI video — lifelike avatars/spokespeople, realistic environments, and product footage that reads as genuine, not synthetic.

Editing direct-response ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube — hooks, UGC-style edits, VSLs, listicles, and demos built to convert.

High-volume variant production — spinning winning concepts into many testable variations (hooks, avatars, scenes, captions, pacing, CTAs, aspect ratios).

Realism QA — catching and fixing the tells that break believability: warped hands, off lip-sync, unnatural motion, lighting mismatches, artifacting.

Format discipline — native 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 cuts optimized per placement.





What You Bring

A portfolio of highly realistic AI-generated video — this is the core requirement. Show us AI footage or avatars that are hard to clock as synthetic.

Deep, hands-on command of AI video generation tools — e.g., Kling, Seedance, Veo, HeyGen/Synthesia (realistic avatars), ElevenLabs (voice/lip-sync) — and the prompting and post skills to push each toward realism.

Strong editing and compositing fundamentals (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut) to grade, retime, clean up, and blend AI output into a seamless finished ad.

A real point of view on DTC / direct-response creative — hooks, retention, sound-off editing, and why the first 3 seconds matter.

Sharp eye for the details that separate believable AI from uncanny, plus speed and consistency at volume.





Nice to Have

Motion graphics/VFX and compositing chops, custom avatar or voice-clone creation, image-to-video and upscaling workflows (e.g., Topaz), familiarity with Meta/TikTok ad and AI-disclosure policies, and a sense for testing angles.



How to Apply

Send your portfolio with: your most realistic AI-generated clip (and how you made it), a DTC ad you edited that performed well, and a rough sense of how many ad variants you can turn around in a week.

title: $2,000–$4,000/mo — Google Review Removal Expert (Online Reputation / ORM Specialist)
description:
Earn $2,000–$4,000+ USD per month doing one specialized thing: getting negative Google reviews removed.



We are Reputation Collective, a fast-growing online reputation management (ORM) company. We sign 250+ new paying business clients every month from the US, UK, EU, Australia, the Middle East and Asia — all with negative Google reviews they want addressed. We have more client demand than we can handle. What we don't have is YOU: the person who can deliver removals. Find them, file them, get them taken down — and we will pay you more than anyone else in this niche.



WHAT YOU'LL EARN





$2,000–$4,000+/month realistic total earnings: $7.50 USD/hour base PLUS commission on EVERY successful removal

There is no cap. More removals = more money. Our strongest performers will earn well above this range

Base rate reviewed upward quickly as you prove results

Weekly pay. Flexible hours. Full-time, long-term, stable — we already have years of client volume waiting

Work directly with the founders. You'll be a core tea
mber, not a cog in an agency





WHAT YOU'LL DO



Take negative Google reviews (any country) and get them removed through Google's official channels: content policy reporting, legal and privacy removal forms, and country-specific submission paths (Germany/EU, UK, US, Australia and more). You'll own the pipeline end to end — assess each review, pick the right channel, prepare and file the submission, track the outcome, report results.



We operate 100% legitimately. No fake accounts, no flagging networks, no paid insiders. If a review can't be removed through a real channel, we tell the client honestly. If that's not how you work, don't apply.



THIS MIGHT BE YOU — even if your job title never said "review removal"



Many of the best people did this work under other names. If you personally got Google reviews taken down while working as any of these, you're exactly who we're looking for:





Online Reputation Management (ORM) specialist at an agency

SEO / local SEO specialist managing Google Business Profiles (GBP)

Virtual assistant or paralegal filing Google legal / privacy / defamation removal forms

Review management or content removal specialist (Google, Trustpilot, Yelp)

Freelancer who handled review disputes and takedowns for your own clients





THE ONE REQUIREMENT (this is the whole interview)



You MUST have real, provable experience removing Google reviews. That's it. You do NOT need perfect English. You do NOT need a fancy resume or a degree. You do NOT need to write a long cover letter.



Proof looks like: screenshots of removal confirmations from Google, before/after links showing a review gone, a tracker from past removal work, or a specific walkthrough of removals you personally handled (which review, which country, which channel, how long it took).



If you can show this, you are already ahead of 99% of applicants and we will fast-track you to an interview within 48 hours.



HOW TO APPLY (takes 5 minutes)



Start your message with the words RED STAR so we know you read this.



Then answer, short and specific:





Roughly how many Google reviews have you removed, and in which countries?

Describe ONE removal you handled: the review, the channel/form you used, and the turnaround time.

What proof can you show us? (Attach it if you can — screenshots welcome.)





That's the entire application. No essays. We are hiring immediately and reply to every qualified applicant within 48 hours.

title: Social Media Strategiest
description:
Social Media Strategist / Calendar Manager (Instagram Lead)  

DTC Health and Wellness Brand (US Focused) · Full-Time · Remote



The Role

- Own Instagram end to end. This is a concept and execution role, not a production one — you'll have an in-house designer and a freelance video editor to bring ideas to life. Your job is to originate the ideas, set the strategy, run the calendar flawlessly, and grow the channel. IG is ~80% of the job; the rest is TikTok and emerging platforms. You're writing the playbook, not inheriting one.



What You'll Do

- Own IG strategy across Reels, Feed, and Stories — and the growth/engagement numbers that come with it

- Originate concepts and hooks — you generate the ideas, then brief the designer and video editor to execute

- Live and breathe competitor and adjacent brands — track what the best DTC wellness brands do well and adapt those plays for our brand, fast

- Run the content calendar at a consistent cadence — flawless execution and timing is non-negotiable

- Build a steady UGC and micro-influencer pipeline

- Report on what's working and turn it into the next content bets



Tools You Should Know

- Scheduling/publishing

- Analytics: native IG Insights plus a social analytics tool (Sprout, Dash Social, or similar)

- Briefing & collaboration: Figma, Notion to brief the designer and video editor cleanly

- Light content tools: Canva, Figma and CapCut for quick mockups and concept references (you brief, the team finishes)

- Listening: social listening / competitor tracking tools (Sprout, or manual swipe-file discipline)



What We're Looking For

- 2–4 years running social for a DTC brand in the US, bonus if experience with wellness or consumer health brand

- A portfolio of Instagram concepts you originated, with real results attached

- A sharp content instinct — you know a strong hook when you see one and can reverse-engineer why competitor content works

- Strong writing and native platform fluency (trends, formats, retention)

- Ruthless calendar discipline — things ship on time, every time

- Reads the metrics that matter (saves, shares, watch time) and acts on them

Bonus: genuine interest in health, wellness and longevity, experience using AI tools to automate and scale social workflows (content ideation, repurposing, scheduling, reporting); paid social or influencer tooling experience.

title: Short-Form Video Editor: TikTok/Reels/Shorts (Scripts Provided)
description:
I am Henry, founder of Alba Talent (
), a UK-registered company. We already generate platform-specific scripts for short-form video content on a daily cron. What we don't have is someone to actually turn those scripts into edited, published video. You'd take scripts we generate (or raw footage our team records) and produce finished vertical video: cuts, captions, pacing, trending audio where it fits, for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



THE ROLE

- Edit raw footage/scripts into finished vertical short-form video (CapCut or similar)

- Add burned-in captions, trim for pacing, cut silence, format for each platform's specs

- Work from scripts we generate on a daily basis (you're not writing content, just producing it)

- Deliver a steady weekly volume: the script pipeline alone generates roughly 15 scripts across the week, so you'd be turning around about that many finished videos to start, with the number growing

- Flag when a script doesn't translate well to video so we can adjust the source



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Real short-form video editing experience: CapCut, Premiere, or similar, with actual published examples

- An eye for pacing and hook-in-first-3-seconds for TikTok/Reels/Shorts specifically

- Comfortable working from scripts/briefs rather than creating concepts from scratch

- Fast turnaround. This is a volume role.



PAY: $5-7/hour to start, based on how much of this you've clearly already done. The strongest, most specific applications start at the top of that range.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with the word PHOENIX so I know you read the whole post. Then send: 1) links to 2-3 short-form videos you've personally edited (not filmed, edited), and 2) how long a typical 30-60 second edit takes you start to finish. Applications missing either get skipped.

title: Project Manager & Writer
description:
JOB OVERVIEW 

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week 

Hours: Fixed schedule — 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday 

Location: Remote (PST hours required) 



Overview 

American Standard Adhesives (ASA), a US-based distributor of hot melt adhesive solutions for B2B industries is looking for a self-starter Project Manager & Writer to execute the marketing initiatives laid out by our Marketing Manager. You will take full ownership of each project from kickoff through completion — driving the work forward independently between milestones and deliverables that the Marketing Manager will check at each step. We've been in the adhesives business for over 20 years. Only candidates with strong English communication (written/spoken) will be considered. 





Responsibilities 





Project Management (~45%) 



Own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle for new products — writing product listings, coordinating packaging design, confirming selling price with finance, and driving through to live launch 



Conduct competitor research on third-party websites and listings — identify what's working, what isn't, and surface recommendations (or execute against direction from the Marketing Manager) 



Coordinate external designers, freelancers, and internal contributors through project management tools 



Lead website content development and refresh cycles end-to-end, partnering with technical staff for chemistry/materials accuracy 



Manage ongoing packaging and collateral design projects (e.g., box labels, user manuals) 





Writing & Content (~45%) 



Own third-party platform product listings — product titles, listing copy, A+ content modules, and mobile-optimized variants 



Develop sales and marketing presentations — capabilities decks, launch slides, and customer-facing collateral 



Own the research, writing, and audience framing for technical content (product articles, application guides, technical sheets) — R&D/chemistry staff own subject-matter accuracy; this role owns translating it into clear, audience-appropriate copy 



Research the target audience for each piece — buyer persona, technical depth, channel — and calibrate tone, positioning, and structure accordingly 



Author and maintain internal documentation and SOPs 





Ad Hoc Operations Support (~10%) 



Provides general administrative and operational support as needed. 





Qualifications 



Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in project management, content writing, and/or digital marketing — we are not training a beginner from scratch 



Strong written and verbal English — clear, professional, and to the point 



Self-starter who executes against a brief and drives it to finished deliverable without hand-holding between milestones 



Comfortable conducting competitor and market research; able to surface insights or execute against a clear research brief 



Highly organized across parallel workstreams; catches errors before they go live 



Experience coordinating with designers, freelancers, or creative teams 



Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, product listing tools, or B2B marketplaces 



Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 



Experience in industrial products, adhesives, or B2B e-commerce is a plus 



Solid understanding of SEO for product listings 





Schedule Requirements 



Full-time, Monday–Friday 



Must work either 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST 



No flexi-time or alternative schedules 



Must be fully available during PST business hours 



Reports to: Marketing Manager 





Please attach your resume.

title: Travel Consultant Support
description:
Job Brief  



We are seeking a highly detailed Travel Administrator to provide essential backend support for our travel operations. This role is responsible for the meticulous management of travel data within the Tramada platform, ensuring that every client profile, booking, and financial record is accurate and up-to-date. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between sales and execution by creating professional, branded itineraries and handling complex financial reconciliations. We are looking for a process-driven professional with significant experience in travel systems who can work independently to maintain a smooth workflow for our travel agents and clients. This role will start part time with the potential to transition to full time after a 3 month performance review.



Responsibilities 

Tramada System Management: Accurately input, update, and manage comprehensive client profiles, booking details, and travel preferences within the Tramada platform. 

Itinerary Development: Process flight, accommodation, and transport bookings by loading data into Tramada and compiling detailed, branded itineraries for client presentation. 

Documentation and Compliance: Generate accurate quotes, invoices, receipts, and other essential travel documents using automated system features while ensuring adherence to branding guidelines. 

Financial Reconciliation: Handle transaction fees, mark-ups, and commissions, including the mapping of GL codes and reconciling financial data within the system. 

Agent and Client Support: Provide high-level administrative support to travel agents to streamline the sales and trip-planning workflow. 

Data Management: Manage and maintain client data integrity to ensure a seamless experience from enquiry to departure. 

Reporting and Analytics: Utilise reporting tools to extract data for CRM management, sales analysis, and management dashboards. 

Workflow Optimisation: Monitor internal processes to ensure all bookings and documentation are handled with speed and precision. 



Requirements 

Minimum of 2 years of experience in the travel industry, with exposure to both corporate and leisure sectors highly preferred. 

Proven track record in a dedicated travel administration or coordination role. 

Exceptional data entry skills with a focus on accuracy and high attention to detail. 

Strong organisational abilities with the capacity to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities. 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills suitable for a professional environment. 

Demonstrated ability to work independently and apply critical thinking to solve administrative problems. 



Software Proficiency 

Core Travel Management – Tramada (Must Have) 

Itinerary Builders – Travefy (Great to Have) 

GDS Platforms – Sabre (Advantageous) 

Productivity Suite – Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Tourism, Travel Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent vocational certification in Travel and Tourism). 



Personal Attributes 

Meticulous – Obsessed with data accuracy and the fine details of a travel itinerary. 

Reliable – A dependable tea
mber who takes full ownership of administrative outcomes. 

Proactive – Able to anticipate the needs of travel agents and prepare documentation in advance. 

Adaptable – Comfortable navigating fast-paced changes in travel schedules and client requirements. 

Customer-centric – Understands that back-office precision directly impacts the client’s travel experience.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100?tivation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

title: Customer Support Rep (Fully Remote)
description:
We’re Hiring: Customer Support Rep (Fully Remote)

_____________________________________________________________



A rare opportunity to learn, grow, and help power one of the fastest-growing home brands

_____________________________________________________________



Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - a fast-growing home and dining brand redefining modern tableware and lifestyle across the US. We are now expanding globally, and only just getting started.



Our vision is simple - when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware, we want them to think of JazzUpCo.



We’ve served over 100,000+ customers and we’re growing fast - which means we’re now looking for someone thoughtful, reliable, and eager to grow, to support our operations and customer experience.



You’ll be part of the engine that keeps our day-to-day running smoothly - supporting our customers, organizing backend operations, and helping us improve how we work as we scale.

_____________________________________________________________



Your Role



You’ll with your team lead, and our customers. Your job is to make sure every customer experience is a smooth one - and that our backend operations stay organized as we grow.



_____________________________________________________________



What You’ll Do:



- Respond to customer inquiries via
, social, and chat platforms (we use Gorgias)



- Resolve issues with care and empathy, ensuring customers feel heard and helped



- Coordinate with warehouse and logistics partners to ensure smooth order fulfillment and tracking



- Monitor reviews, identify trends in feedback, and suggest improvements to our systems



- Support daily operations tasks - tracking returns, updating records, and keeping things organized



- Collaborate with the team to improve our SOPs and backend workflows



- Be the voice of the customer - bringing feedback to the team to help us improve



You don’t need to have all the answers - we’ll teach you the tools and systems. What we care about is your attitude: someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute ideas along the way.



_____________________________________________________________



Who We’re Looking For:



- Empathetic & Patient Communicator: You write and speak with warmth and clarity, and genuinely care about helping people.



- Reliable & Detail-Oriented: You keep things organized, catch the little things, and follow through consistently.



- Tech-Savvy & Process-Oriented: You enjoy systems, tools (Notion, Slack, Gorgias etc.), and figuring things out when things aren’t working.



- Eager to Grow: This is a full-time employee role - not a freelance or part-time gig. We’re looking for someone fully committed to growing with us long-term. You won’t be juggling other jobs. Instead, you’ll be part of the team, learning across different areas of the business, gaining new skills, and building something meaningful together.



- Team Player: You work well with others, ask good questions, and love contributing to a positive team vibe.



_____________________________________________________________



Why Work With Us:



- 100% remote, full-time role with paid time off and other benefits



- Learn directly from the founder and team lead with hands-on mentorship



- Join a high-growth brand where your work actually matters - no layers, no red tape



- Be part of a team that values excellence, growth, and fulfillment



_____________________________________________________________



Our Culture



We believe culture fit is key. Skills can be trained, but the right mindset, attitude, and shared values are what make the magic happen here. Our culture is built around 3 pillars:



E — Excel

If we’re going to do something, we do it with care and pride.



F — Fulfilment

We find meaning in the work we do - and how we do it.



G — Growth

We believe everything can be learned. And we’re committed to growing together, day by day.



_____________________________________________________________



The Journey Ahead:



Step 1: Apply - Tell us about yourself through the application



Step 2: Interview - If shortlisted, we’ll get to know you and see if it’s a good fit for both sides.



Step 3: Trial Task - A short task to see how you approach real situations.



Step 4: Offer & Onboarding - If it’s a match, we’ll kick off with a 60-day onboarding and probation period to get you trained up and integrated into the team.



At the end of this onboarding and probation phase, if we’re aligned and excited to move forward together, your position will be confirmed as a full-time tea
mber - with continued mentorship, support, and a clear path for growth ahead.



_____________________________________________________________



Ready to be part of something exciting?

Apply now - we can’t wait to meet you!

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
Responsibilities



Market & bench building

*Build and continuously expand TriArc’s qualified trade partner database by trade, geography, capacity, and performance.

*Run ongoing prequalification (financials, safety, workload, bonding) in coordination with Accounting.



Bid strategy & scheduling

*Publish the rolling Bid Calendar; align milestones with Estimators/PMs and owners/architects.

*Break down drawings/specs into clear trade packages; assign scope sheets and alternates.



ITB execution

*Prepare Invitation to Bid packages (drawings, specs, addenda, bid forms, alternates, due dates, delivery method).

*Post to BuildingConnected; segment targeted lists; personalize top-tier outreach.



Relentless follow-up

*3-touch cadence (Day 1
 + Day 3 call/text + Day 5 confirmation) and pre-deadline “nudge” to secure commitments.

*Track interest/no-bid reasons; backfill gaps early; escalate risk areas to Estimating.



Bid intake & leveling

*Receive bids, confirm inclusions/exclusions, and level against scope sheets; flag outliers and VE options.

*Package a clean Bid Leveling Matrix for Estimators/PMs with award recommendation.



Data & feedback loops

*Score and rate trade partner performance post-award (price accuracy, quality, safety, schedule).

*Run post-bid debriefs; capture lessons learned to refine future ITBs.



Brand & relationship

*Be TriArc’s front door for subs: fast answers, fair process, respectful communication, and values-based partnership.



Required Traits & Skills

*Excellent Communication Skills

*Hunter mentality: proactive, persistent, upbeat on the phone; comfortable making 30–50 quality contacts/day in peak cycles.

*Construction fluency: understands typical scopes (CSI divisions), alternates, addenda, and gaps that derail bids.

*Process discipline: lives in checklists, documents everything.

*Communication: crisp writing, professional phone presence, tact with hard-bid deadlines.

*Values fit: Do what you say • Do the right thing • Gumption • Stick-to-itiveness • Passion/Enthusiasm.



Nice-to-Have

*Customer Service / Appointment Setting experience

*GC pre-con/bid desk experience or supplier/manufacturer rep background.

*Existing DFW sub network across interiors, ground-up flex/industrial, retail shells.



Technical Requirements:

*Computer: Intel i5 processor or equivalent with at least 8GB RAM

*Internet: Minimum 50 MBPS download speed

*Dual Monitor is required

*Noise cancellation headset

*HD Cam (Clutter Free, Ideally Plain Well-lit background)



Job Details:

Job Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM CDT - Monday to Friday 9:30 PM - 5:30 AM PHT

Salary Range: PHP 70,000 – 90,000 monthly, depending on experience.

With front-of-house and admin now handled internally, we're bringing on a dedicated Social Media & Marketing VA to own our digital presence and paid advertising. This is a marketing-led role for someone who can take raw content and run with it, not a support role dressed up as marketing.



Hours & Setup



Full-time, Monday to Friday (Start off Part time)

Day time hours

Remote, fully independent setup

Long-term role with genuine growth as we expand to additional locations and scale fleet contracts





What You'll Be Doing

Social Media & Content Creation



Manage and grow our Instagram, TikTok, and
 accounts

Receive raw video footage and edit it into polished, platform-appropriate content — Reels, TikToks, Stories

Write captions, develop a content calendar, and maintain a consistent publishing cadence

Produce content that feels authentic to a real workshop — not generic, not corporate



Google Ads Management



Take full ownership of our existing Google Ads account

Optimise campaigns for conversion — leads and bookings, not vanity metrics

Report on spend, leads generated, and cost per acquisition

Proactively flag underperforming campaigns and recommend changes before we have to ask

Support future campaigns for new locations and fleet-specific targeting



Admin & Bookkeeping Support (Secondary)



Regular Xero reconciliation

Overflow quoting and invoicing support via Mechanic Desk when required

Customer follow-ups and general comms via Podium

Assist with SOP documentation as we build out business systems



Systems & AI



Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to support content drafting, SOP development, and efficiency tasks

Help build a replicable, scalable version of this role that works across future locations





What We're Looking For

Experience



Demonstrated social media management experience — Instagram, TikTok, and
, not just personal use

Hands-on Google Ads campaign management and optimisation (non-negotiable — setup alone doesn't count)

Automotive or trade industry background — this is a hard requirement, not a preference. You need to know the difference between a valve cover gasket and a rocker cover gasket without Googling it

Xero experience, even at a working level

Video editing experience — CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or equivalent; mobile editing minimum, desktop preferred



Technical Skills



Google Ads — active campaign management, bid strategy, performance reporting

Social media scheduling tools — Later, Buffer, Meta Business Suite, or similar

Video editing software at a production-ready level

Mechanic Desk — training provided, but fast uptake essential

Xero — reconciliation and general bookkeeping tasks

Podium — training provided

AI tools — comfortable using and building with Claude and/or ChatGPT



Communication & Work Style



Strong written English for captions, ad copy, and customer communication

Proactive — you send updates without being asked

Comfortable working with two decision-makers and navigating that without friction

Able to receive a loose brief ("here's a video, do something with it") and return a finished product — no hand-holding required





You'll Thrive Here If You Are…



A natural content creator. You can take a shaky phone video from a busy workshop and turn it into something worth watching. Raw material doesn't faze you.

Automotive-literate. You understand workshop culture well enough to create content that actually resonates — not just stock-photo-style posts that could belong to any business.

Performance-obsessed with paid ads. You treat ad spend like it's your own money. You check, adjust, and report without being prompted.

Brief-friendly. Fast-moving business owners don't always have time to write a detailed creative brief. You work with what you're given and deliver.

Self-directed and consistent. You publish on schedule, track what's working, and don't let things drift when no one's watching.

Data-aware. If engagement drops or cost-per-click climbs, you notice it first and bring a solution, not just a problem.

Built for growth. You're not thinking about this role as it is today — you're interested in what it looks like when we're running multiple locations and scaling fleet contracts.

Job Title: Administrative Assistant & Bookkeeper (Full-Time, Long-Term)



Type: Full-time

About Us

We run two growing businesses — AdminAssist Ally (managed private AI assistants for companies) and TradeStockApps (trading tools and apps). We're an early-stage, fast-moving team, and we're looking for an organized, detail-oriented person to keep our administrative and financial house in order as we scale.



The Role

This is a hybrid administrative and bookkeeping role supporting both companies. You'll keep our finances clean, organized, and always ready — so that when US tax time comes, everything can be handed straight to our US-based CPA with no scramble. You'll also handle general administrative work that keeps the business running smoothly.



What You'll Do

- Bookkeeping: record and categorize income and expenses, reconcile accounts, and keep our books accurate and up to date

- Payroll: help manage payroll for our team (mostly Philippines-based), tracking payments

- Financial organization: maintain clean, well-organized records and reports so our US CPA has everything needed at tax time

- Administrative support: general admin tasks, document organization, scheduling, and keeping things on track across both companies

- Reporting: prepare simple financial summaries so we always know where we stand



Must Have

- Solid bookkeeping experience (recording, categorizing, reconciling)

- Payroll experience

- Strong organization and attention to detail — this role lives and dies by accuracy

- Comfort with accounting/bookkeeping software (QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, or similar)

- Good written English and reliable daily communication

- Familiarity with US financial and tax concepts — enough to keep US-tax-ready books (you won't be filing taxes; you'll be keeping records organized for our CPA)



Nice to Have

- Experience supporting US-based businesses or working with a US CPA/accountant

- Experience with spreadsheets at a high level (Excel/Google Sheets)

- Experience across multiple companies or entities

- General virtual assistant / executive assistant background



We're Looking For

Someone dependable, discreet, and genuinely organized who wants a long-term role and takes ownership of keeping things in order. You'll be handling sensitive financial information, so trustworthiness is essential. As we grow, this role grows.



How to Apply

Start your application with the word LEDGER-READY so we know you read this. Then tell us: (1) your bookkeeping and payroll experience, (2) what accounting software you know, (3) any experience you have with US-based businesses or US tax-ready record keeping, and (4) your availability.

Read this before applying



This role is about ONE thing: static ads for Meta 
 and Instagram).

Logo designers

Why we are hiring



We already know which static ad templates win. What we need is someone who can take those winning templates and turn them into on-brand versions for each of our clients — quickly, accurately, and at high volume. That is a full-time job on its own, and we want one dedicated person who owns it.



The role



You take proven, winning static ad templates from our template library (Konvert), rebuild them in Canva, and adapt them for each client based on a brief. You are not designing from a blank page — you are executing a proven system with speed and precision.



Day to day you will:



Take winning static ad templates from Konvert and import/rebuild them in Canva

Apply the right client brand assets on top: logo, colors, fonts, product images

Make the small adjustments the brief calls for: swap the headline, adjust the copy, resize, tweak layout details

Follow the brief exactly — the right client, the right message, the right assets, every time

Work inside Notion: pick up your tickets, update statuses, deliver files where the brief says

Produce a high volume of finished, on-brand static ads every single day

You are a good fit if you



Have real experience designing static ads for Meta 
/Instagram feed and story formats) and a portfolio full of them

Understand what makes a paid ad work: strong hook/headline, clear product focus, readable at thumbnail size, built to convert — not just to look pretty

Are very strong in Canva — fast, confident, and know its features inside out

Can navigate Notion comfortably (tickets, statuses, finding briefs and assets)

Have a sharp eye for brand consistency: right logo placement, exact brand colors, correct fonts, clean spacing

Read briefs carefully and follow them precisely — no "creative liberties" that break the brief

Can produce high output at consistent quality, day after day

Communicate clearly in written English and flag it early when something in a brief is unclear or an asset is missing

Are reliable and consistent. This is a "show up every day and ship" role

Canva is a must (not optional)



This is a hard requirement. You need strong, real, daily-driver knowledge of Canva:



Building and editing designs fast (not just dragging in templates)

Brand kits, fonts, and color management

Working with layers, groups, grids, and alignment

Resizing and exporting in the right formats and dimensions for Meta ads (feed, story, etc.)

If you only use Canva casually, this is not the role for you.



Bonus points



Experience at a performance marketing / DTC / e-commerce agency shipping paid social creative

Experience working with template systems like Konvert (or similar)

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Lead)
description:
About EETech

EETech is a dynamic technology company committed to delivering innovative digital commerce solutions. Our global team collaborates to create cutting-edge platforms that drive success for our clients. We value creativity, technical excellence, and a forward-thinking approach to solving complex challenges.



Job Overview

EETech is looking for a senior, highly technical QA Automation Engineer/Lead to take ownership of quality assurance across our SaaS products and custom website implementations. This is not an entry- or mid-level role — we need someone who has already led QA initiatives, built automation strategy from the ground up, and can operate with minimal oversight. You'll be expected to bring proven expertise in test automation, drive process improvements, and mentor and guide QA practices across teams. This position is ideal for a self-directed, senior QA professional who thrives on solving complex quality challenges and shaping how a growing team approaches automation and testing.



Key Responsibilities

1/ Automation Strategy & Leadership

_Own and drive the QA automation strategy across web and mobile applications, working independently with minimal oversight.

_Design, develop, and maintain advanced automated test scripts and frameworks, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.

_Lead automation initiatives end-to-end — from tool evaluation and architecture decisions to rollout and adoption.



2/ QA Process Improvement

_Identify gaps in existing QA processes and implement measurable improvements across both SaaS products and custom website implementations.

_Establish and evolve QA best practices, standards, and testing strategy as the product and team scale.

_Bring a track record of having enacted similar process improvements in previous roles.



3/ Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

_Collaborate with development and product teams to define test requirements and ensure comprehensive coverage.

_Analyze test results, track issues, and drive defects to resolution promptly.



4/ Framework & Tool Enhancement

_Evaluate and implement new automation tools and best practices to enhance testing efficiency and accuracy.

_Maintain and evolve test suites in response to new feature development and changing product needs.



5/ Documentation & Reporting

_Create detailed test plans, test cases, and technical documentation to support automation efforts.

_Provide clear, concise reporting on test outcomes, quality metrics, and areas for improvement to stakeholders.



6/ Collaboration & Agile Practices

_Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

_Partner with cross-functional teams and, where needed, mentor junior QA tea
mbers.





Qualifications

1/ Experience

_7+ years of software QA experience, including 3–5 years in a senior or lead capacity.

_Demonstrated, hands-on experience leading QA automation initiatives with minimal supervision.

_Proven track record of enacting QA process improvements for both SaaS products and custom website implementations.

_Experience in a remote work environment with strong communication and time management skills.



2/ Technical Skills

_Deep proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, or Java.

_Strong, advanced experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Appium).

_Solid working knowledge of CI/CD tools and processes (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).



3/ Soft Skills

_Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail.

_Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to guide QA direction and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.

_Comfortable operating autonomously and taking ownership of outcomes.



4/ Preferred Qualifications

_Experience with performance and load testing tools.

_Prior experience mentoring or leading a QA team.

_Knowledge of agile development methodologies and continuous testing practices.

title: Detail-Oriented Video Editor Needed — Fast-Paced, High Volume (Full-Time)
description:
About us: We're an established digital agency running two active YouTube channels focused on business automation and tutorial content, with a consistent, growing publishing schedule. This isn't a one-off gig or a project that might disappear next month — we're building a long-term team and looking for someone to grow with us as content volume scales. You'll have a direct line to the person reviewing your work, with clear, consistent expectations from day one.



We produce high-volume YouTube content (talking-head + tutorial style videos) for two channels, with output scaling up to multiple videos per day. We're looking for someone to join long-term, not gig-hop.



What matters most to us, in order:



- English fluency — you must be able to read, understand, and catch spoken English clearly enough to spot every clipped word, mispronunciation, or awkward cut. This is non-negotiable.

- Zero tolerance for errors — no clipped words, no missing syllables, correct spelling and grammar on every caption/title/graphic, every single time.

- The video must make sense — if a cut breaks the logic or flow of what's being said, it's wrong, even if it's technically clean.

- Speed that can keep up with volume — we move fast. You'll need to turn around videos on a tight, recurring schedule without quality dropping.





Software: We currently use Descript. Experience with Descript is a plus, but NOT required — if you're highly skilled in Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut and can hit our quality bar, we will consider you, and can train you on Descript.



What you'll be doing:



- Editing talking-head and tutorial-style YouTube videos from raw footage/transcript

- Removing filler words, dead air, and mistakes while preserving natural flow

- Adding simple hook-style openers (we'll give you direction — this is not complex motion graphics)

- Basic captions, text overlays, and b-roll placement

- Careful, full-video proofreading before delivery — spelling, grammar, and continuity





What you will NOT be doing:

- Thumbnail design (handled separately)

- Uploading/publishing (unless later expanded)



Hard skills required:



- Strong English reading/listening comprehension (able to catch clipped words, mispronunciations, and awkward phrasing by ear)

- Video editing proficiency (Descript preferred; Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut also considered)

- Caption/text overlay accuracy — zero spelling or grammar errors

- Basic understanding of pacing and narrative flow in tutorial/talking-head content





Soft skills required:



- Deadline-driven — can consistently hit a recurring turnaround schedule under volume

- Self-starter — doesn't need hand-holding once given direction

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER - Finance, Systems & Scale
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER



The Nordstick (HepPros LLC) | Remote | Full-Time



ABOUT THE NORDSTICK

The Nordstick is a fast-growing DTC fitness equipment brand built around premium functional products like the NordBench Pro. We have grown 400%+ year over year and are scaling aggressively. Our operation runs on Shopify with a pre-sale model, a manufacturing partner in Hong Kong, and a 3PL network across multiple U.S. warehouse locations.

Operations at The Nordstick is not admin work. It is cash flow management, inventory intelligence, execution speed, and margin protection.

We are looking for an elite Operations Manager who can think like a CFO, execute like an operator, and build systems that scale.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND IS NOT)



This role is not:

--> Updating spreadsheets without context

--> Reacting to problems after they happen

--> Overbuying inventory "just in case"

--> Managing ops without understanding cash flow



This role is:

--> Owning the 13-week cash flow forecast

--> Making inventory decisions tied to demand and capital

--> Using Shopify, data, and AI to stay ahead of issues

--> Coordinating across multiple 3PLs for speed and margin

--> Turning CX signals into product and process improvements

--> Being the connective tissue between our manufacturer in Hong Kong, our 3PL partners, our CS team, and leadership



WHO YOU ARE

You are not just operationally great. You understand money. You know what cash on hand means, why contribution margin matters, and how inventory decisions ripple into the P&L. You have built financial models before, not just maintained them, and you can walk a founder through a cash flow forecast without needing a finance team behind you.



You think in systems. You do not chase fires. You build the infrastructure that prevents them. When something breaks, you fix the root cause, not the symptom.



You are comfortable with AI tools, not just as a user but as a builder. You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to ship actual working systems, and you can maintain and improve what already exists.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



CASH FLOW AND FINANCIAL PLANNING

--> Build and own a rolling 13-week cash flow model, updated weekly, covering in-stock and pre-sale scenarios

--> Forecast inventory buys, marketing spend impact, loan repayments, and shipping and fulfillment costs

--> Model best-, base-, and worst-case scenarios

--> Model inventory financing decisions: Shopify Capital, working capital loans, supplier payment terms, and loan vs. payback rate tradeoffs

--> Know cash on hand, weekly burn, weekly contribution margin, and profitability to one decimal at all times

--> Ensure The Nordstick stays in stock without overbuying or locking up cash



INVENTORY AND DEMAND FORECASTING

--> Forecast demand using Shopify sales data, growth rates, seasonality, and marketing plans

--> D
 when and how much to reorder to prevent stockouts that kill 
ntum and overstock that traps capital

--> Manage POs from factory confirmation through container receipt, including ETD/ETA tracking and customs clearance via our freight forwarder

--> Track batch-level inventory counts and maintain the allocation sheet as the source of truth for CS order messaging

--> Monitor warehouse storage costs and manage dead inventory decisions in coordination with leadership

WORKING CAPITAL AND GROWTH FINANCING

--> Leverage Shopify Capital, working capital loans, and supplier terms strategically

--> Provide units-on-hand and container count data for leadership's negotiations with the manufacturing partner

--> Participate in tariff strategy decisions with the customs broker, including PSC filings and Section 232 duty refund coordination

--> Balance growth speed with financial safety; capital is used strategically, not emotionally



SHOPIFY AND SYSTEMS OWNERSHIP

--> Be deeply fluent in Shopify Admin: order-level actions, SKU management, fulfillment status, and operational data

--> Own operational data: orders, refunds, shipping costs, and inventory

--> Build and maintain dashboards, Google Sheets models, and custom reports

--> Bonus: ability to build custom dashboards or internal tools using Python, SQL, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script



3PL AND SHIPPING OPTIMIZATION

--> Manage our 3PL relationships across multiple U.S. warehouse locations using ShipHero and ShipStation

--> Maintain FIFO allocation rules across warehouses, manage priority-adjusted orders, and approve or deny partial shipments based on fulfillment logic

--> Manage the warehouse-level approval process for inbound POs, including specifying which SKUs go to which warehouse location based on velocity and buffer strategy

--> Track average shipping cost per unit weekly, by zone, and blended; reduce average shipping zones over time

--> Evaluate per-unit carrier cost tradeoffs for bulk freight and individual shipments

--> Maintain and update landed cost per unit as COGS, freight, and tariff conditions change

--> Escalate and track fulfillment errors through to resolution



CX TO OPS TO PRODUCT FEEDBACK LOOP

--> Work closely with Customer Support to identify repeat product issues, confusion points, and return drivers

--> Maintain the product issue and parts request tracker, categorized by defect type: product defect, instruction failure, info/expectation failure, and missing parts

--> Track issue counts weekly and trend over time to surface whether product changes are reducing complaints

--> Fix problems at the source by recommending improvements to instructional videos, setup guides, and product design

--> Serve as the primary source of truth for CS on shipping timelines by product and order date range



AI AND EFFICIENCY LEVERAGE

--> Work hands-on with agentic AI tools, specifically Claude Code, to build, maintain, and improve internal operational systems

--> Build and maintain existing dashboards and reporting tools; this is not a "use AI to summarize" role, it requires actual implementation work

--> Automate reporting, flag anomalies, and reduce manual work across the ops function

--> Identify new automation opportunities and scope them into working tools, not just proposals

--> Follow the principle: AI handles repetition, humans make decisions



WEEKLY REPORTING

--> Produce a Weekly Ops State of the Union for the CEO covering: North Star KPI movement, inventory health, fulfillment dates, shipping zone breakdown, product issue counts, and 13-week cash runway

--> Coordinate with marketing on customer lists tied to batch ship dates for
 sends

--> Work with finance on PO creation, payment coordination, and Shopify/ShipHero cleanup ahead of incoming shipments



TOOLS YOU WILL USE DAILY

--> Shopify Admin: order-level actions, SKU management, and fulfillment status

--> ShipHero: warehouse inventory management, FIFO allocation, PO tracking, and partial shipment logic

--> ShipStation: individual order shipment management

--> Google Sheets: 13-week cash flow model, ops dashboard, allocation sheet, reshipment tracker, and shipment timeline tracker

--> Slack: cross-functional coordination with CS, marketing, finance, and leadership

--> Asana: task tracking and project management

--> Richpanel: visibility into CS ticket data related to ops issues

--> Freight forwarder portal: freight tracking and customs documentation

--> Triple Whale: awareness of how ops data (COGS, shipping cost) affects profit reporting



NORTH STAR KPIs

You will be evaluated monthly on three metrics:

--> Average Shipping Cost per Unit: direction: down month over month

--> Average Time to Ship to Customer: direction: down month over month

--> Product Reliability Index (product-related issues per 100 orders): direction: down month over month

If two or more are improving, Ops is winning. If one or fewer are improving, we are not. No debate. No overrides.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves:

--> Proven experience in DTC or e-commerce operations, ideally with pre-sale or made-to-order inventory models

--> Strong financial literacy: cash flow forecasting, margin analysis, working capital management

--> Advanced Google Sheets skills; ability to build and maintain financial models with real data

--> Shopify fluency: operations, not just navigation

--> Experience managing inventory and fulfillment across multiple 3PLs

--> Hands-on experience with agentic AI tools, specifically Claude Code; you must be able to build with it, not just prompt it

--> Ability to build and maintain internal dashboards and operational reporting tools

--> Systems thinker: you prevent problems, not chase them

--> Strong communicator who proactively loops in CS, marketing, and leadership without being asked

Strong Bonus Points:

--> Built cash flow dashboards and models before; must be able to show samples

--> Experience scaling fast-growing DTC brands

--> AI-assisted coding experience (Python, SQL, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script using tools like Claude Code or Cursor)

--> Experience working with freight forwarders and customs brokers

--> Familiarity with ShipHero or a comparable WMS



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

--> In-stock rate without cash strain

--> Clean, accurate cash flow visibility at all times

--> Lower shipping cost per order month over month

--> Fewer CX issues caused by ops failures

--> Faster decisions with less chaos



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to 

--> Your resume

--> An intro video, under 5 minutes, where you introduce yourself and answer why you believe you are a good fit for this role

--> A link or sample of a cash flow model or financial dashboard you have built and maintained before

--> A Loom or Zoom recording walking us through that sample work



Applications without the sample work and video will not be reviewed.
