title: Full-Time FRENCH SPEAKING Video Editor & Content Operator for Premium Leadership Communication Brand
description:
About Demoria



Demoria is a French speaking premium leadership and communication training company helping founders, executives, and senior professionals become clearer, more trusted, and more powerful communicators.



We create high-quality educational content around leadership, trust, communication, persuasion, presence, decision-making, and speaking under pressure.



We are looking for a FRENCH SPEAKING full-time remote video editor and content operator to join us long-term.



This is not a low-level editing role where you simply cut clips together. We are looking for someone with strong taste, excellent reliability, and the ability to help turn raw footage into polished, premium content.



You will work closely with the founders and help us build a serious content engine across YouTube, short-form video, and social media.



This Role Is For Someone Who Thinks Like an Editor, Not Just a Cutter



We do not want generic edits, loud effects, cheap transitions, or “viral” editing that damages trust.



Our brand needs to feel premium, elegant, intelligent, calm, and authoritative.



You should understand how to make educational content engaging without making it look cheap.



You should be able to take long-form footage and identify:



what the strongest moments are

what should become a full YouTube video

what should become a short-form clip

what should be cut, tightened, or restructured

where pacing is too slow

where the message needs more clarity

how to make the final piece feel polished, premium, and trustworthy

What You’ll Do

Long-Form Video Editing



You will edit long-form YouTube videos, usually between 15 and 50 minutes.



These may include:



educational videos

leadership communication lessons

talking-head videos

training excerpts

podcast-style discussions

webinar or programme material

founder-led thought leadership content



You will be expected to improve:



pacing

structure

clarity

sound quality

visual polish

viewer retention

emotional flow

overall premium feel



You should know how to keep a video engaging without over-editing it.



Short-Form Content



You will repurpose long-form footage into short-form clips for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and LinkedIn.



This includes:



identifying strong moments from long-form footage

creating 30–90 second short-form clips

adding clean captions/subtitles

creating strong opening hooks

maintaining brand consistency

avoiding cheap, noisy, overdone editing styles



The short-form content should feel sharp, intelligent, and premium — not gimmicky.



Content Management & Publishing Support



You will help manage the content workflow from raw footage to publication.



This may include:



organising raw footage

naming and storing files clearly

maintaining a content calendar

preparing video exports

uploading/scheduling content

writing or formatting basic titles/descriptions

preparing subtitle files

tracking what is completed, in progress, and blocked

keeping our video library organised



You must be very organised. We do not want to chase you for updates.



Basic Graphic Design



You should be able to create or support simple visual assets such as:



YouTube thumbnails

clean title cards

simple social graphics

branded templates

course/video covers

basic carousel-style assets



We are not looking for loud influencer design. We want refined, clean, premium visuals.



Experience with Canva, Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, or similar tools is useful.



AI-Assisted Workflow



You should be comfortable using AI tools to work faster and better.



Useful tools may include:



Descript

ChatGPT

Claude

CapCut

Runway

ElevenLabs

Midjourney

Canva AI

Adobe AI tools

OpusClip or similar clipping tools

transcription and subtitle tools



You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be curious, efficient, and willing to test better workflows.



We care about quality first. AI should improve the work, not make it generic.



Monthly Output



The expected monthly workload will usually include:



4–8 long-form videos per month

short-form clips repurposed from long-form footage

social media/content management

basic thumbnail or graphic support

organisation of footage and project files



The exact output will depend on the complexity of each video.



Quality matters more than rushing.



We’re Looking For Someone Who

has strong French language skills

title: Finance Process & Controls Analyst
description:
The Finance Process & Controls Analyst is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of financial transactions across the Company's business systems. This role serves as the "exception detective" for Finance, proactively identifying failed transactions, process breakdowns, integration issues, and billing discrepancies before they impact customers, vendors, financial reporting, or cash flow.



The candidate possesses exceptional analytical skills, relentless attention to detail, and a passion for investigating complex problems. Rather than simply processing transactions, this individual will continuously improve business processes, identify automation opportunities, and partner with Finance, Operations, IT, and ERP teams to build scalable, highly reliable financial processes.



FLUENT ENGLISH - READING, SPEAKING, COMPREHENSION required

OBSESSIVE ATTENTION TO DETAIL





Key Responsibilities

Transaction Monitoring & Exception Management

Monitor daily financial transactions across NetSuite and integrated business systems.

Identify invoices, purchase orders, receipts, customer orders, vendor bills, inventory transactions, and journal entries that failed to process correctly.

Investigate exceptions to determine root cause.

Resolve discrepancies or coordinate resolution with the appropriate business teams.

Ensure all identified exceptions are tracked through completion.

Revenue & Billing Assurance

Validate customer invoices for completeness and accuracy.

Verify pricing, taxes, freight, discounts, quantities, customer-specific billing rules, and contract terms.

Identify missing or duplicate invoices.

Monitor order-to-cash workflow for failed or incomplete transactions.

Perform reconciliations between operational systems and NetSuite.

Procure-to-Pay Controls

Review vendor invoices for accuracy and completeness.

Investigate purchase order mismatches.

Monitor receiving, vendor bill matching, and approval workflows.

Identify duplicate payments or processing errors.

Validate tax treatment and coding.





Required

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related field.

5-10 years of experience in accounting, finance operations, ERP systems, business process improvement, or financial systems.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Exceptional organizational and documentation skills.

Outstanding attention to detail.

Ability to investigate complex issues independently.



NetSuite experience.

ERP implementation experience.

SQL knowledge.

Power BI.

Power Automate.

Celigo or other integration platforms.

Process mapping experience.

Internal controls or audit experience.

Lean or Six Sigma exposure.

title: CAD Engineer
description:
The client designs and manufactures engine-mounted compressor and alternator drive kits, mounting brackets

and related components for refrigerated transport. The CAD engineer reverse-engineers, designs and details

these parts so they can be manufactured and fitted correctly first time, and delivers all design data into

the client's ownership in editable form. The role covers laser-cut steel brackets, machined components and

castings, along with the assembly drawings, bills of material, exploded views and fitting manuals that go with

them.



Output drives real production and customer fitment, so fit, dimensional accuracy and clear, manufacturable

drawings matter more than speed.



Inputs (what the engineer receives)



? A Ramair part number (RMxxxx) issued before any new part is started, with the part modelled, drawn and

filed to that number.

? A design brief covering the application: compressor or alternator model, belt arrangement, pulley

specification, mounting interface, target vehicle or engine, and the product line it belongs to (for example a

Euro 6 variant, an alternator mount kit, or a TCCI QP30 conversion).

? 3D scan data of the target engine, compressor or vehicle interface, supplied as raw scan or mesh, to

design the part around.

? Physical or in-production samples, photographs and hand measurements where a scan is not available or

needs confirming.

? Reference material: existing similar kits, the relevant native files (DXF or Parasolid) from the Engineering

Folder for revisions, prior BOMs and install guides.

? Component and interface specifications: compressor mounting patterns, pulley dimensions, fastener

standards, and any supplier constraints from the laser cutter, machinist or foundry.

? Ramair drawing templates (A4 and A3), title blocks and the part numbering convention.

Activities (the work expected)

? Clean and interpret 3D scan data into usable reference geometry for design.

? Design laser-cut brackets, machined parts (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks) and castings,

modelled in 3D and built to be edited and revised cleanly.

? Engineer the spacer stack, compressor or alternator position, pulley plane and belt alignment so the

assembly is correct and serviceable.

? Produce manufacturing data in the correct format for each part type, as set out under Outputs.

? Create detail drawings with full dimensions, tolerances, materials, finishes and machining operations.

? Create general assembly drawings showing what goes where, with spacer diameters and lengths called

out explicitly.

? Generate bills of material and exploded views, and produce graphics for assembly and fitting manuals.

? Apply design-for-manufacture judgement and resolve queries with suppliers so parts are made without

avoidable back-and-forth.

? Incorporate changes found during first production or sample checks, and keep every revision controlled.

? Maintain and tidy the Ramair drawing templates, fastener and part libraries and naming, improving them

over time.

? Over time, support two programmes: re-mastering the existing active range into clean editable models,

and digitising newly acquired product ranges.



CAD Engineer | Role description



Outputs (what the engineer delivers)



For every part, the editable native CAD and the matching PDF, delivered into the Ramair Engineering Folder

under the assigned RM number, never as a sole copy held elsewhere.



? Laser-cut brackets: individual DXF files for cutting, a detail drawing (PDF) for each, and a general

assembly or detail drawing (PDF) for manufacture and assembly.

? Castings: two Parasolid models, machined and unmachined, a detail drawing (PDF) for machining

operations and tolerances, and a general assembly drawing (PDF).

? Machined items (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks): a Parasolid 3D model and a detail

drawing (PDF).

? Assemblies: a 3D assembly model, a bill of material in a structured format (spreadsheet or CSV), and

exploded views (PDF or image, with the source assembly file retained).

? Manuals: exploded views and step graphics suitable for assembly and fitting instructions, generated once

a design is tested and finalised.

? Revision control: CAD and PDF always issued at the same matched revision, with a short changelog

noting what changed.



Where the working software allows, the parametric source file is delivered as well as the neutral formats, so

Ramair holds fully editable design data.



Quality criteria



Good looks like



? The part fits first time. Mounting points, interface to the scanned geometry, belt alignment and pulley

planes are all correct.

? The spacer stack is fully resolved, with spacer diameters and lengths stated clearly and correctly. This is

the single most common failure point and must be right.

? Drawings are unambiguous, fully dimensioned and toleranced sensibly, and the part can be made exactly

as drawn.

? Tolerances are appropriate to function, tight where it matters and open where it does not, so cost is not

driven up needlessly.

? CAD and PDF match at the same revision every time, filed correctly to the RM number with native files

included.

? Models are clean and structured so the next change is quick to make.

? Exploded views and manual graphics are clear enough to fit from without guesswork.

Bad looks like

? The part needs rework to fit, has missing or wrong mounting points, or causes belt misalignment.

? Spacer dimensions are missing, wrong or only discoverable by measuring the model.

? Drawings are under-dimensioned, untoleranced or not manufacturable as drawn.

? CAD and PDF are out of step, or a revision is issued without updating both.

? Only PDFs are delivered, or native files are withheld or filed in the wrong place.

? The numbering convention or templates are ignored.

? Models are messy and cannot be revised without rebuilding.

Because these parts sit inside the OEM warranty position that protects Ramair's market, a part that does not

fit has real downstream cost at the dealer. Changes that affect fit are validated against a sample before

release.



Timeframes (indicative turnaround, to be confirmed)



These are starting points, measured from when the part number, brief and scan data are provided, and should

be set against Ramair's real cadence. The clock does not start until inputs are complete. Missing scan data,

samples or a part number pauses the timeframe.

Other expectations



? Ownership of work product: all designs, models, drawings, scan-derived geometry and source files are

Ramair's intellectual property. The engineer signs an IP assignment and confidentiality agreement,

delivers all native and source files into Ramair's repository, and retains no sole copies.

? Toolset: work is done in a mainstream CAD package that reads 3D scan data and exports Parasolid and

DXF cleanly (for example SolidWorks, Inventor, Solid Edge or Fusion). Ramair owns or standardises the

licensing and file formats so the work is portable and the role can scale or change hands without

recreating files. The design data must never be locked to one person's private licence or machine.

? Version control and filing: incremental versioning, matched CAD and PDF, a changelog, and consistent

filing to the RM numbering scheme in the Engineering Folder.

? Validation: work to a simple change-control process and support sample checks before a changed part

goes live.

? Communication: responsive asynchronous communication across time zones, clear acknowledgement

of briefs, and weekly visibility of work in progress and queue.

? Confidentiality: designs, customer information and the fitment and warranty sensitivities are treated as

commercially confidential.

? Capacity to scale: able to absorb a backlog over time, including re-mastering the existing range into

editable models, the fitting-manuals programme, and digitising newly acquired product lines.

title: Commercial Property Valuer
description:
# Commercial Property Valuer (Offshore, Full-Time)

**Property Lions | Remote — Must work Australian Eastern Time hours**



## About Us

Property Lions is a Sydney-based commercial real estate group operating across buyer's agency, property management, and funds management. We specialise in value-add commercial and industrial acquisitions in the $5M–$25M range across Australia, using a rigorous, data-driven approach to deal analysis. We're growing our research and analysis capability and looking for an experienced valuer to support our acquisitions pipeline.



## The Role

We're looking for an experienced commercial property valuer to join our team full-time, supporting feasibility analysis and market research for live deals across Australian commercial and industrial submarkets. This is not a client-facing valuation role — it's an internal research and analysis position embedded in our deal team, feeding directly into acquisition decisions, cap rate assessment, and exit strategy.



You'll work closely with our founder and deal team, translating raw market data into clear, defensible numbers that inform real investment decisions.



## Key Responsibilities

- Prepare feasibility reports and financial models for prospective commercial and industrial acquisitions

- Conduct comparable sales and leasing research across target submarkets (industrial, commercial, retail)

- Analyse cap rate trends, rental growth, vacancy rates, and yield benchmarks by region

- Support due diligence on prospective deals, including lease abstraction and rent reconciliation

- Build and maintain market data trackers across multiple Australian states and submarkets

- Assist with valuation inputs for internal investment committee papers and investor reporting

- Research zoning, planning, and infrastructure factors relevant to site value and highest-and-best-use assessment

- Work directly with the founder to stress-test assumptions on live deals



## What We're Looking For

- Demonstrated experience in commercial property valuation (industrial, office, retail, or mixed commercial assets)

- Strong understanding of valuation methodology — direct comparison, capitalisation, and discounted cash flow approaches

- Experience preparing or contributing to feasibility studies and investment analysis

- Strong Excel/financial modelling skills

- Excellent written English — reports need to be client- and investor-ready

- Familiarity with Australian commercial property market conventions (an advantage, not mandatory)

- Self-directed, comfortable working with minimal daily supervision once ramped up



## Working Requirements

- **Full-time**, working Australian Eastern Time (AEST/AEDT) business hours

- **Reliable, high-speed home or office internet connection** — this role involves live data work and regular video calls, so connection stability is essential

- Own laptop/desktop capable of running standard office and modelling software

- Quiet home or office work environment suitable for video calls



## Why Join Us

- Work directly with a fast-growing Australian commercial property business

- Exposure to real, live acquisition deals from $5M to $25M+

- Long-term full-time role with room to grow into a broader analysis/research position as the business scales



## How to Apply

Please submit your CV along with a short summary of your commercial property valuation experience, including the types of assets you've valued and any feasibility or investment analysis work you've done. Include answers to the following questions:

1. Who did you support in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?

2. Who is the Treasurer of Australia?

3. What's your hobbies and interests?

title: Video Editor for Educational Tattoo Content (Long-Term)
description:
Hi, my name is David, and I’m the founder of Tattoo Fanatics, an online tattoo education brand focused on creating high-quality educational content for tattoo artists.



I’m looking for a detail-oriented video editor for a long-term position.



About the Role



I film 3–4 hour tattoo practice sessions on 4” × 6” fake skin. Your job is to transform this long-form footage into clean, structured 3–5 minute rough edits by matching my existing reference videos.



This is not a creative or flashy editing role. There are no motion graphics, captions, voiceovers, or storytelling required. The focus is consistency, clarity, and following an established editing style.



I handle the final stage of editing (voiceover, captions, final trimming, and publishing).



Responsibilities



* Review long-form tattoo footage

* Remove unnecessary or repetitive sections

* Compress demonstrations into a clean 3–5 minute edit

* Match reference videos closely in pacing and structure

* Organize project files and exports clearly

* Deliver edits on time and consistently



Requirements



* Experience editing video content (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar)

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow reference examples precisely

* Organized workflow and file management

* Reliable communication

* Interest in a long-term working relationship



Application Instructions



To show you’ve read this posting carefully, begin your application with:



“Golden Needle.”



Please also include:



1. Your portfolio or 2–3 editing samples

2. How long you’ve been editing

3. Your internet speed

4. Your weekly availability



In 1–2 sentences, explain why you think you are a good fit for this role.



Additional Notes



The workload may vary week to week depending on filming output. Some weeks will be lighter, some heavier. This is a long-term role for someone who can grow with the Tattoo Fanatics brand.

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager — DracoSlides

**TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager — DracoSlides**



**About the Brand**



DracoSlides is a premium comfort slides brand based in North America. We sell on TikTok Shop and are growing fast. Our slides feature a suede memory foam insole, adjustable velcro straps, and a streetwear-first aesthetic. Think socks with slides, baggy fits, and the kind of product people actually want to show off.



**The Role**

You'll be the person finding creators, reviewing their profiles, reaching out to them, managing samples, sourcing TikTok Live sellers, and making sure affiliates are actually posting and converting.



**What You'll Do**



- Search TikTok Shop's creator marketplace and find affiliates who fit our brand (streetwear, sneaker culture, lifestyle, men's fashion)

- Send outreach messages to qualified creators and follow up with affiliates who ghosted after receiving samples

- Source and recruit creators specifically for TikTok Live selling — we generate strong revenue from livestreams and need people who can actually sell on camera

- Stay on top of TikTok trends and proactively suggest video formats, hooks, and content angles that will work for our product

- Track affiliate performance weekly and escalate top performers for paid partnerships or higher commissions

- Manage the full sample request queue — approve, reject, or message creators based on their profile



**What We're Looking For**



- Hands-on experience with Cruva (required — this is our primary tool for managing affiliates)

- Experience with TikTok Shop seller tools (creator marketplace, sample requests, Seller Center)

- Strong eye for content — you should be able to watch a creator's recent videos and quickly assess whether they can move product

- Experience sourcing or managing TikTok Live sellers is a strong plus

- Solid English writing for creator outreach and follow-ups

- Self-directed and organized — you'll be managing a daily queue without someone micromanaging you

- Bonus: familiar with Claude AI or other AI tools for outreach and research



**Compensation**



- Fixed monthly rate (discussed based on experience)

- Performance bonus tied to affiliate GMV



**Hours**



Full-time



---



**To Apply — Complete Both Tasks First**



Applications without these will not be reviewed.



---



**Task 1: Diagnose These Affiliates**

- 520,000 followers

- Total brand GMV generated: $8,430

**Affiliate 

- 18,000 followers (fast growing)

- Videos posted for us: 44 | Lives: 3

- Total brand GMV: $15,599

- Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $54,530

- Content quality score: 91/100

**Affiliate

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER (GHL SPECIALIST)

Go Ignite  |  Fully Remote  |  Monday-Friday  |  7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

PHP 80,000/month + OTE  |  Prepaid HMO  |  Paid Time Off



If you can build a full GHL white label environment from scratch, run paid ads that convert, and own results end-to-end -- read on. 



If you have never led a team, need hand-holding, prefer to execute someone else's strategy, or are not ready to commit to a full 8-hour day with an international team -- this role is not for you.



Go Ignite is hiring one person for this role. We are not filling a seat. We are building our internal digital engine, and we need someone who has done this before at a high level.



This role is NOT for you if:

You have only used GHL as an end-user - proven sub-account builds, white label setups, and A2P/10DLC experience are required

You have never managed paid campaigns for Australian or US-based clients

You cannot show us real outcomes: funnels you built, ads you ran, metrics that moved

You are looking for someone to tell you what to do every day

You have never led, coordinated, or managed a marketing team or direct reports

 

About Go Ignite

Go Ignite is the growth and technology division of a specialist international recruitment group connecting top Filipino talent with high-growth Australian and US businesses. We build the systems -- the funnels, automations, and campaigns - that power candidate attraction and client conversion at scale. This is an internal hire. You will own the tools that drive the business.



The Role

You will lead the Go Ignite marketing function. The marketing team reports directly to you, giving leadership full visibility without day-to-day involvement. You own the GHL ecosystem, drive paid campaign performance, and set the standard for how the team executes and grows. This is a player-coach role -- you build, you lead, and you are accountable for results.



These are the five areas you will own:



Team Leadership & Direction

Lead and coordinate the Go Ignite marketing team -- you are the go-to for direction, prioritisation, and performance

Set weekly priorities, run team check-ins, and ensure campaigns and systems are moving without requiring escalation to the owner

Build and maintain SOPs so the team operates to a consistent standard and scales without bottlenecks

Report to the business owner on team performance, key wins, and strategic recommendations.



GHL Systems & Automation

Full white label environment management: sub-account setup, affiliate manager configuration, A2P/10DLC registration and compliance

Build and maintain lead generation funnels, automation workflows, nurture sequences, appointment booking flows, and CRM pipelines from scratch

Provide technical support and troubleshoot across workflows, deliverability, domains, and third-party integrations

Develop SOPs and documentation so systems scale without you as a single point of failure.



Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta 
/Instagram), Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube -- ad creatives and copy are supplied by the team

A/B test audiences, landing pages, and ad sets using performance data and AI-driven insights

Manage CPL, ROAS, and conversion targets across Australian and US market campaigns



Web, Integrations & Landing Pages

Maintain WordPress sites: forms, tracking pixels, domain configuration, webhooks, Zapier integrations

Build high-converting landing pages that support campaign objectives



Analytics, Reporting & Social

Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports across GHL dashboards, Google Analytics, and ad platforms

Support social media content scheduling and brand presence using AI tools and content calendars

Recommend improvements across funnels, paid ads, and
/SMS campaigns based on data. 



What You Must Bring

3+ years hands-on experience as a GHL Specialist or Digital Marketer -- not as a VA who uses GHL, but as someone who builds in it

Proven full white label GHL setup experience: sub-account creation, affiliate manager config, A2P/10DLC registration

Demonstrated paid ads results on Meta and/or Google Ads for Australian or US clients -- you have screenshots, ROAS data, or client outcomes to show us

WordPress integration skills: pixels, tracking, domains, webhooks, Zapier

Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, or similar) for content and automation tasks

Excellent written and spoken English -- you communicate directly with an international team daily

Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating a marketing team -- you know how to set direction, give feedback, and drive accountability

Self-directed, organised, and able to manage multiple campaigns and people without daily supervision

 

Why This Role Stands Apart



Most GHL roles in the Philippines are VA-level: follow the SOP, raise a ticket, wait for approval. This is not that.

You own the GHL ecosystem -- architecture decisions are yours

You work directly with the leadership team, not through layers of management

You see the full picture: how funnels feed ads, how ads feed the pipeline, how the pipeline drives revenue

You lead the marketing team -- this is a genuine step into a Head of Marketing function

International exposure with Australian and US market campaigns -- resume-building work with real accountability 

Compensation & Benefits



PHP 80,000/month base + OTE

Base salary: PHP 80,000/month. On-target earnings (OTE) are payable on top of base, tied to agreed performance outcomes. Total compensation for a strong performer exceeds base.

Prepaid HMO (ask us about dependent coverage options)

Paid Time Off

Fully remote -- work from anywhere in the Philippines

Full-time, 40 hours/week | Monday-Friday | 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

Direct access to leadership and real career growth as the business scales



How to Apply

We review every application personally. We do not shortlist candidates who skip these steps.

1. Your updated CV

2. A 2-3 minute video introduction: who you are, why this role is the right next step, and a walkthrough of one GHL build you are proud of

3. Your portfolio -- funnels, automations, ad campaign results,
 sequences -- anything with measurable outcomes (Google Drive, Notion, or Loom links are fine).

4. A written answer to the screening question below, included in your application message

Screening Question (required):

Walk us through a GHL white label setup you have completed end-to-end. What did the configuration involve? How did you handle A2P/10DLC registration? What did the finished client environment look like, and what were the results for the client?



Applications without a written answer to this question will not be reviewed.

If your application is strong, you will hear from us within 3-5 business days.

Schedule: Strong overlap with US Pacific Time (PST/PDT) business hours required.

title: Paid Ads Manager + GHL Automator

You run the campaigns that generate leads, and you connect the systems that catch, route, and follow up with those leads inside GHL. Both sides of this role exist to produce measurable results for our clients.



This role has a direct growth path. As we scale, you will have the opportunity to build and lead the paid media function underneath you. We are looking for the person who becomes that leader.



You will be responsible for:

• Building the internal SOPs and processes this team will run on as it grows



You are a fit if:

title: LinkedIn Content Writer and Engagement VA for Australian Mining Sector Business (Part Time, Same Timezone)
description:
About the business

We are an Australian company in the mining and resources sector based in Perth, Western Australia. Perth runs on the same timezone as the Philippines, so this is a normal daytime role. No night shifts, no split shifts.

The role

You will run our LinkedIn presence across two channels: the founder's personal profile, which is the priority, and our Company Page, which is secondary. Writing is the core of this job. If you write clear, natural, professional English that does not sound like AI, keep reading.

Your weekly tasks:



Draft 3 to 4 posts for the founder's personal profile in his voice. You will get voice notes, rough ideas and examples of his style. Drafts are loaded into Buffer and approved before anything publishes.

Draft replies to comments and inbox messages for approval.

Publish 2 to 3 posts to our Company Page as a content admin, mostly repurposed from the personal content.

Build a weekly list of posts, people and companies worth engaging with in mining and resources.

Research content ideas and industry news.

Create simple graphics in Canva.

Send a short weekly report on impressions, followers and leads.



A note on access: you will work through Buffer and Company Page admin access. You will never be asked for, and will never be given, a LinkedIn password. Everything on the personal profile goes through an approval step. This protects you as much as it protects us.

Requirements



Excellent written English. This will be tested with a paid trial task.

At least 1 year managing LinkedIn or another platform for a business owner or executive.

Experience with Buffer or a similar scheduling tool.

Confident with Canva.

Reliable internet, own computer, and available for a 15 minute daily check in on Perth time.



All of the content needs to look like it was written creatively and thoughtfully by a human, not by ai - this is very important to our brand



Nice to have

Experience writing for B2B, recruitment, mining, engineering or trades audiences.

Pay and conditions

15 hours per week, Monday to Friday. PHP 25,000 to 35,000 per month depending on experience, negotiable for the right person. Paid weekly for the first two months, then twice monthly. 13th month pay after 12 months with us. Annual performance review and raise.

How to apply



Start your application with the word TMM.

Include links to 2 LinkedIn posts, profiles or pages you have written or managed.

In 3 sentences, tell me the difference between a LinkedIn post that gets engagement and one that gets ignored.



Applications that skip these three steps will not be read.
